title: Statistical Foundations of Reinforcement Learning: A Non-Asymptotic Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.41903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) embodies a foundational paradigm for sequential decision-making in the face of uncertainty. The rapid growth of model complexity in emerging applications has significantly amplified the challenges of achieving data-efficient RL, particularly in sample-starved scenarios where data collection may be costly, time-consuming, or even high-stakes. Consequently, understanding and improving the data efficiency of RL algorithms has become a central problem of both fundamental theoretical interest and practical importance.   Despite decades of research, the statistical underpinnings of RL remained remarkably underdeveloped until relatively recently, particularly in the finite-sample regimes most relevant to modern practice. translated_title: 强化学习的统计基础：非渐近视角
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）体现了在不确定性条件下进行序贯决策的基础性范式。新兴应用中模型复杂度的快速增长，显著加剧了实现数据高效强化学习的挑战，尤其是在样本匮乏的场景中——这些场景下数据收集可能成本高昂、耗时漫长，甚至涉及高风险。因此，理解并提升强化学习算法的数据效率，已成为一个兼具基础理论意义和实际重要性的核心问题。尽管经过数十年的研究，强化学习的统计基础直到近期仍相当不完善，特别是在与现代实践最为相关的有限样本情形下。过去几年中，借鉴高维统计学、概率论和信息论的思想，推动非渐近统计强化学习理论前沿的研究活动大量涌现……
tldr: 本文系统阐述了强化学习的非渐近统计理论基础，聚焦于在有限样本情形下理解并提升强化学习算法的数据效率这一核心问题。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically lays out the non-asymptotic statistical foundations of reinforcement learning, focusing on understanding and improving the sample efficiency of RL algorithms in finite-sample regimes.
